info.thermal.fortune_cookie_bad_luck.0: Help! I am trapped in a Fortune Cookie bakery.

info.thermal.fortune_cookie_bad_luck.3: Fate likes you. Luck does not.
info.thermal.fortune_cookie_bad_luck.4: Hope you're smart or pretty. You are NOT lucky.
info.thermal.fortune_cookie_luck.2: Better to be lucky than good.
info.thermal.fortune_cookie_luck.3: Do or do not. There is no try.
info.thermal.fortune_cookie_luck.4: Who needs brains or looks? You have luck!
